requirements.requirement: Storage box - enclosed volume for storage
requirements.evidence: 2x2 cell box from 4 full bases (piece:0,0,0;full etc) with 4 top covers forming lid deck and 14 side end caps sealing perimeter via capOpenFaces

Four top covers cover:0,0,0;full;top etc are plain type and retain their integrated magnets (setCoverMagnets on:true is default, verified NO_CHANGE when trying to add magnets). Magnets in lid pull to steel inserts/adjacent magnets to hold shut.

finish.summary: Built 2x2 storage box with four lidded cells, capped sides and bolted joints. Lid is four plain covers with integrated magnets retained to hold shut.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
